entities.summary: The Hanzal Mosque is a mosque in Sana'a, Yemen. It is the second oldest mosque in Sana'a after the Great Mosque. It lies to the west of Al-Tahrir Square, near the offices of the Ministry of Civil Services and north of the Egyptian Embassy.
